properties.description:
Given a primitive (and optionally a sign or sub-kind), the vocabulary returns the edge types whose declared reading matches, sorted, so a projection or rule can be written by MEANING. The first reader to move onto it is the owner's call: the reasoning projection that dec:a-projection-is-named-and-the-battery-runs-over-it (2026-08-14) chose as the first slice was never built and carries three open sub-questions (where it is served, whether a projection is a node or a list, which centrality); and the six existing private lists (structural_rule, is_traceability_edge, RISK_EDGES, COMMITMENT_EDGES, ARTIFACT_BOOKKEEPING and the five projection lists) each encode a purpose-specific judgement that a primitive alone may not reproduce, so moving one needs a stated rule, not a lookup.

SEQUENCED ON ANTHONY'S WORD, 2026-09-28: option (c) — the first PR (feat/every-edge-type-declares-what-it-means) ships the declared readings, the one-line and full serving, and edge_types_read_as with its test, and moves NO existing rule onto them. Which reader goes first (the unbuilt reasoning projection, or one of the six private lists under a stated rule) is left for a follow-up PR, after he has reviewed the 65 classified readings.

PER-EDGE, NOT PER-TYPE — added to the same PR on Anthony's word, option (a), 2026-09-28, after fact:some-edge-types-are-several-relations-split-by-a-property-value-so-a-per-type-reading-is-wrong-for-part-of-them-2026-09-28 found four edge types that are several relations under one name. A reading may declare `splits`: a property of the edge and the reading each of its values selects, applied in order with a later match replacing an earlier one (CAUSES reads `basis`, then a `refuted` `validation_status` overrides it). Negation is an operator on a reading (`negated`), and a negated reading matches no selection. Selection now answers in two parts: edge_types_read_as returns the types that ALWAYS mean the primitive, apart from those decided PER EDGE, and edge_reads_as / edge_is_read_as decide one edge from its own values. An unset property reads at its schema default, so an unannotated CAUSES edge is `correlational`, a correlation and not a cause; a list property gives one reading per value. What a split CANNOT see is the target node: AUTHORED_BY `approver` means the word was given on an accepted node but only asked for on a proposed Decision, so its split reading carries no sign and says so in its note — the sign is the node's status. The two hand-written filters that drop CONTRADICTS `supporting` (heal.rs:1950, report.rs:2253) are candidates to move onto edge_is_read_as in the follow-up, not in this PR.

FIFTEEN, NOT FOUR — Anthony, 2026-09-28: "yes to 1, go with the classifier for observed". The classification's own `subtypes` records gave per-value readings for eleven more edge types, and all eleven went into the same PR as splits:
- Six become a different relation by value: DEPENDS_ON, CHANGED, YIELDED, ANNOTATES, DUPLICATES and VIOLATES_RULE.
- Five change only the possibility: SATISFIES, DEPLOYED_TO, REQUIRES_RESOURCE, GOVERNED_BY and SCHEDULED_FOR.
CAUSES `basis=observed` reads as a cause, seen with no mechanism given: the classifier's reading, on Anthony's word. The co-occurrence reading first written made `observed` mean what `correlational` already means.
Two readings depart from the classification, and the review sheet says so. YIELDED `merged` is source-of ∧ same-as, not plain same-as, because the fragment is not the node; its extracted mention is. DEPENDS_ON `error_flow` is given data_flow's direction, which the classification did not state.
Three readings turn on the node at the FAR END, so a split on the edge cannot express them and they stay as notes: the AUTHORED_BY approver, CONTAINS from the project against one from a component, and SCHEDULED_FOR a Release. Reading those needs endpoint sorts, option (e) of dec:idea-the-schema-declares-what-each-relation-means-in-primitive-terms.
`optional` on DEPENDS_ON stays a modality modifier rather than a split. A split REPLACES the reading, so a split on it could not soften a data flow without erasing the flow.
properties.name: A rule or projection can select edge types by their declared reading instead of by a private list of names
